answer: Under EigenTrust-style factorization, reputation flows through reciprocity-weighted endorsements, while exponential temporal decay with a fixed half-life steadily erases stale influence. A freshly spawned identity has negligible eigenvector centrality and little transitive support; it must accumulate sustained, mutually validated honest service over the horizon before its score can affect consensus. A lotus cannot claim the river’s accumulated trust at launch, so sybil identities remain below consensus thresholds.
